quotes: assert added["room"]["name"] == SCRIPT_ROOM  # stored as given
assert "<script" not in html.lower()  # no script element, the value's included
assert SCRIPT_ROOM in page.text()  # shown as that text
verdicts.why: The check verifies that this specific room name is stored unchanged, appears as parsed text, and does not become a script element. It does not establish the universal claims for every stored value or prove that no stored value is ever evaluated or executed in all contexts.
